name: @bojackduy/opencode-voice
description: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech for OpenCode. Record voice prompts with whisper-cpp, hear responses via Piper TTS, with LLM normalization through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run fmt
scripts.release:patch: npm run check && npm test && npm version patch -m "chore: release %s" && git push fork master && git push fork $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:minor: npm run check && npm test && npm version minor -m "chore: release %s" && git push fork master && git push fork $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:major: npm run check && npm test && npm version major -m "chore: release %s" && git push fork master && git push fork $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
